_meta.description: ILM for agent-monitors-cache-erosion-* (monthly index agent-monitors-cache-erosion-YYYY-MM, FRE-543/FRE-1036 monthly-index convention; ~24 docs/day at the default hourly interval, cheap retention). min_age-based delete from index creation (no rollover write-alias, mirrors the joinability/SLM-health precedent). Retention: 123d (owner rule 2026-10-03: a monthly index keeps the current month plus 3 full months; the longest 4-month run is 123 days; was 90d), matching the SLM-health policy this probe is closest in cadence to. warm forcemerge fires at 32d so the current monthly index isn't merged while still open.
